# VHF radio

The marine VHF radio is how boats talk to each other, marinas and the coastguard. Channel 16 is for distress and calling; switch to a working channel to talk. Listen for weather and tidal notes before [[Chart navigation|plotting]] a passage.

## Mayday call

Say "Mayday" three times, the boat name, position, nature of distress and number of people aboard, then wait for the coastguard to answer.

## Radio checks

Ask for a radio check on a working channel, never on 16, and keep the handheld charged in the cockpit.
